summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Santee School District to issue $30,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities.

tax.text: A yes vote supports authorizing the issuance of $30 million in bonds for the school district.
tax.quote: Measure BB, a $30 million bond proposal

schools.text: A Yes vote would approve a $30 million bond proposal for the Santee School District.
schools.quote: The email concluded that the association has signed the ballot argument for the district’s Measure BB, a $30 million bond proposal, “with no conditions.”

tax.text: A no vote opposes authorizing the issuance of $30 million in bonds for the school district.

schools.text: A No vote would reject the $30 million bond proposal for the Santee School District.
